recentItems.title: Inside core disaster-hit area of Gyirong Port, China's Xizang
recentItems.description:
Xinhua correspondents are on the ground near the border gate of the Gyirong Port, where rescuers are racing to search for survivors and reopen the highway into the disaster zone. A deadly mudslide, caused by an ice-rock avalanche in Nepal, hit Gyirong Port on Aug. 26. More than 2,000 personnel are involved in the ongoing rescue operation. (recorded hours earlier)
#Xinhua #GyirongPort #Xizang #Rescue #mudslide

recentItems.title: Charm Unveiled | A giant mine goes green: Anshan breathes new life into its industrial past
recentItems.description:
From an open pit reaching 426 meters below sea level to a lush urban "green lung"!
Ansteel Group in Anshan, northeast China's Liaoning Province, is using nearly 300 million cubic meters of tailings to backfill the open pit of the Dagushan Iron Mine. This eco-friendly project has been transforming waste into 172 hectares of vibrant green space that connects with the Qianshan Scenic Area.
A powerful testament to China's industrial green evolution!

recentItems.title: Live: 3-hour trek becomes 30-minute ride as China's "Cloud Shuttle" serves students in Yunnan
recentItems.description: September marks the start of a new school year for most schools in China. In Nizhuhe Village, Yunnan, students once trekked for more than three hours along cliffside paths to get to school. Now, a "Cloud Shuttle" of cliff elevators and aerial cable cars cuts the journey to about 30 minutes. Join Xinhua for a live ride through the Nizhu River Grand Canyon. #Education #RuralRevitalization #CloudShuttle
